landing.access: Access is provisioned for your editorial team.

workflow.title: How it works
workflow.discoverBody: Choose RSS and public Telegram sources. Editorial AI evaluates the material and surfaces relevant stories.
workflow.reviewBody: Compare model suggestions, edit each platform’s draft and generate an image that fits your brand.
workflow.publishBody: Save the content you want to keep. Approve a draft, publish now or schedule it, and follow its delivery status.
workflow.platforms: X · Telegram · Instagram — configured destination accounts

control.title: Made for your editorial team.
control.body: A dedicated installation with your media brands, sources and destination accounts already configured.
control.brandsBody: Use News Runs for source-led content and Promo Runs for promotional briefs, guided by each brand’s policies.
control.visibilityBody: Track ongoing work, inspect failures and see model usage and recorded cost.
control.languageBody: Work in either interface language. Choose the language of each draft separately.
